method: a read-only count over the fleet's Postgres task queue: statuses counted where created_at >= since; runs = done + skipped + failed (queued rows excluded)
correction: 2026-09-26: runs was published as 1002, a count(*) that included two queued rows; the method sums the three terminal statuses to 1000.
trimmed: Trimmed on 2026-11-18: the method no longer names the internal database host, address, table or tool, and the derived failure percentage was withdrawn from all public text (the queue stores no failure reason).
